source.inspectionScope: Fresh full28-line owned patch read. Removes only two old_configure assignments, keeping set_config for MOZ_BUNDLED_FONTS and commtopsrcdir. Fixed exact block retains both current values. No Gecko configure engine or configure/build execution.

commit fa8a53cb820a1ca83feee5c3ee5514280cd20e39
Author:     Heather Ellsworth <heather@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Thu Apr 17 11:44:39 2025 -0600
Commit:     Heather Ellsworth <heather@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Thu Apr 17 11:44:39 2025 -0600

    Bug 1961229 - Port bug 1957021: Remove old_configure_assignment from mail/moz.configure. rs=bustage-fix

diff --git a/mail/moz.configure b/mail/moz.configure
index ad923904f58..4d41c5816fa 100644
--- a/mail/moz.configure
+++ b/mail/moz.configure
@@ -40,7 +40,6 @@ def bundled_fonts(is_windows, is_linux):
 
 
 set_config("MOZ_BUNDLED_FONTS", bundled_fonts)
-add_old_configure_assignment("MOZ_BUNDLED_FONTS", bundled_fonts)
 
 
 @depends(build_environment, "--help")
@@ -50,7 +49,6 @@ def commtopsrcdir(build_env, _):
     return join(topsrcdir, "comm")
 
 
-add_old_configure_assignment("commtopsrcdir", commtopsrcdir)
 set_config("commtopsrcdir", commtopsrcdir)
